title.zh-TW: 診斷指令新增專注網路選項，快速檢測連線與協定狀態
title.en: Focused Network Option Added to Doctor Command for Rapid Diagnostics

body.zh-TW:
當終端機突然連不上伺服器或回覆中斷時，快速抓出是本機環境還是網路連線出問題至關重要。⟦如同音響工程師拿著導線專用測試儀，以前排查雜音得把整套擴大機與調音台拆開通盤安檢，現在只要接上線頭就能單獨測量訊號導通狀況。⟧現在診斷工具新增了 `codex doctor --network-only` 參數選項。這項指令只針對設定、連線能力與 WebSocket（雙向即時通訊的網路協定）狀態做診斷。當你在公司內部網路或代理伺服器環境下遭遇請求逾時，只要打：

```bash
codex doctor --network-only
```

終端機就會只回報設定、連線與 WebSocket 這三項的檢查結果。
body.en:
When the terminal suddenly loses connection to the server or replies are cut off, quickly pinpointing whether the issue lies in the local environment or the network connection is critical. ⟦An audio engineer uses a dedicated cable tester: whereas troubleshooting noise previously required dismantling and inspecting the entire amplifier and mixing console, plugging in the leads now immediately tests signal continuity on its own.⟧ The diagnostic tool has now added the `codex doctor --network-only` option. This command runs diagnostics exclusively on configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket (a networking protocol for bidirectional real-time communication) status. When encountering request timeouts in corporate intranets or proxy environments, you simply run:

```bash
codex doctor --network-only
```

The terminal then reports only the configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket checks.

items.original: Added `codex doctor --network-only` for focused configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket diagnostics. (#57606)

title.zh-TW: 獨立執行器隨附於正式安裝包，整頓背景服務與建置工具
title.en: Standalone Executor Shipped in Official Packages Alongside Service and Build Improvements

body.zh-TW: 在建置環境部署與升級工具時，底層架構的打包完整度與資源釋放直接影響執行穩定。正式釋出的命令列工具與 app-server（應用程式背景伺服器）安裝包中，現在已直接隨附獨立執行器。背景服務修復了執行緒啟動與關閉時的競爭衝突，執行完成後會即時釋放占用資源。同時，macOS 上若安裝路徑包含中文等非 ASCII 字元，或程式仍在使用中，獨立版本的清理錯誤也已修好。在專案建置方面，Bazel 改採原始碼自編譯的 V8 引擎，搭配相符的 Rust 綁定並支援 Windows 原生 MSVC 封裝；開發與正式發行版本也全面標準化至 Node.js 24.22.1 與 Rust 1.95.0。以往在特定路徑清理失敗或背景程序殘留資源的問題，現在都已排除。
body.en: When deploying and upgrading tools in build environments, the packaging integrity and resource release of underlying architectures directly dictate execution stability. Canonical CLI and app-server (application background server) release packages now bundle the standalone executor directly. The background service fixes thread startup and shutdown races, promptly releasing occupied resources upon completion. Meanwhile, standalone release cleanup errors on macOS when installations are in use or paths contain non-ASCII characters such as Chinese have also been resolved. For project builds, Bazel switches to source-built V8 with target-matched Rust bindings and native Windows MSVC archive support. Development and release builds are also standardized across the board on Node.js 24.22.1 and Rust 1.95.0. Past issues where cleanups failed on specific paths or background processes left lingering resources are now eliminated.

items.original:
Fixed standalone release cleanup on macOS when installations are in use or paths contain non-ASCII characters. (#57503)
Fixed app-server thread startup and shutdown races and released completed runtimes promptly. (#57787, #57788)
Switched Bazel to source-built V8 with target-matched Rust bindings and native Windows MSVC archive support. (#57164, #57269, #57644, #57832)
Shipped the standalone executor in canonical CLI and app-server release packages. (#57837)
Standardized development and release builds on Node.js 24.22.1 and Rust 1.95.0. (#57168, #57373)

entries: Changed `agy acp` to offer every model available to your account to every ACP client, where previously only a fixed list of editors were offered models other than Gemini.

Changed the tabs in `/config` during `--remote-agent` sessions from `Local` and `Remote` to `TUI` and `Remote Agent`, so it is clear that one configures the terminal UI and the other the remote agent; the settings on each tab are unchanged.

Improved how quickly the agent moves on after a terminal command exits while a background process it started still holds the command's output open, which now takes at most about 1 second instead of 5.
Improved subagent rows above the prompt so a subagent that is blocked waiting on you names the tool it is waiting on, such as `Blocked · AskQuestion`, instead of `Blocked · Processing...`.

Improved how plugin OAuth credentials are protected in the terminal sandbox: a plugin's real token now replaces its stand-in only in a request's `Authorization` header, so a command can no longer get a website to echo the real token back by sending the stand-in in another header or in the URL.

Fixed several `agy acp` session bugs: closing, reloading, or resuming a session while a prompt runs now ends that prompt as `cancelled` instead of leaving it hanging, cancelling a prompt no longer also stops the next prompt sent right after it, `session/update` notifications no longer arrive after the `session/prompt` reply for that prompt, and permission requests and question forms now close when they are answered elsewhere or their prompt ends, instead of blocking later prompts or receiving their answers.

Fixed file edits on Windows failing with `target content not found` in files that use CRLF line endings, so edits now match whichever line endings the file uses and the lines they insert keep the file's line endings.

Fixed agent-run commands on Windows failing or returning garbled text when their output contains non-ASCII characters, by running Python in UTF-8 mode (`PYTHONUTF8=1`, unless you have set `PYTHONUTF8` yourself) and switching PowerShell's output encoding to UTF-8.
Fixed stdio MCP servers on Windows leaving their child processes running after the server stops, which could lock plugin folders and make plugin upgrades fail because the files were in use.
Fixed `agy plugin` commands being unavailable, with no plugin marketplaces listed, when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`) or through an enterprise model gateway.
Fixed the built-in `browser` agent being listed among the agents you can start a conversation with, since it is meant to run only as a subagent, which it still does.
Fixed copy-on-select and `/copy` inside GNU screen, so copied text now reaches your clipboard and long selections no longer leave stray characters in the terminal.

title.zh-TW: agy acp 開放帳號所有可用模型，支援任何 ACP 客戶端
title.en: agy acp Opens All Account Models to Any ACP Client

body.zh-TW: 在偏好的程式碼編輯器中透過 `agy acp` 串接模型時，挑選清單不再受工具種類限制。⟦如同走進連鎖咖啡廳，以前只有旗艦店的機台能點選特調飲品，其他分店只能選基本美式；現在只要登入同一個會員帳號，每台點餐螢幕都會列出帳號可選的所有品項。⟧過去只有少數列在固定名單上的編輯器，才能挑選 Gemini 以外的模型，其他串接的用戶端都無法選用。現在這項限制已經移除。只要是你帳號有權限使用的模型，`agy acp` 都會完整提供給每一個連接的 ACP 客戶端。
body.en: When connecting models through `agy acp` in your preferred code editor, the selection list is no longer limited by the type of tool. ⟦Picture walking into a chain coffee shop: previously, only ordering kiosks at flagship locations let you select specialty drinks, while other branches offered only a basic Americano; now, as long as you log into the same membership account, every ordering screen lists all items available to that account.⟧ In the past, only a small number of editors on a fixed list could choose models other than Gemini, while other connected clients could not use them. This restriction has now been removed. As long as a model is available to your account, `agy acp` provides it completely to every connected ACP client.

items.original: Changed `agy acp` to offer every model available to your account to every ACP client, where previously only a fixed list of editors were offered models other than Gemini.

title.zh-TW: 遠端代理模式的分頁標籤重新命名，清楚區分介面與遠端設定
title.en: Tabs in Remote Agent Mode Renamed to Clearly Distinguish UI and Agent Settings

body.zh-TW: 只要加上 `--remote-agent` 參數開啟遠端工作階段，並輸入 `/config` 調整選項，畫面上方的分頁名稱便有了更精確的標記。⟦好比音響擴大機上的旋鈕標籤，以前只印著「本機」與「遠端」，讓人摸不清到底在調螢幕還是外接喇叭；現在直接改印「顯示面板」與「外接音箱」，看字面就知道在調整哪一部份。⟧以往這類工作階段裡的設定分頁標為 `Local` 與 `Remote`，容易讓人混淆各自掌管的範圍。現在分頁正式改為 `TUI` 與 `Remote Agent`，清楚表明一邊用來設定終端機介面，另一邊專門調整遠端代理。兩個分頁底下的所有設定項目本身都維持不變。
body.en: Whenever you start a remote session with the `--remote-agent` flag and enter `/config` to adjust options, the tab names at the top of the screen have more precise labels. ⟦Think of knob labels on an audio amplifier: previously, they were only printed with "Local" and "Remote," leaving you unsure whether you were tuning the screen or external speakers; now they are printed as "Display Panel" and "External Speakers," making it clear from the text alone which part is being adjusted.⟧ Previously, the configuration tabs in these sessions were labeled `Local` and `Remote`, making it easy to confuse the scope governed by each. The tabs are now officially changed to `TUI` and `Remote Agent`, making it clear that one configures the terminal interface and the other specifically adjusts the remote agent. All settings under both tabs remain unchanged.

items.original: Changed the tabs in `/config` during `--remote-agent` sessions from `Local` and `Remote` to `TUI` and `Remote Agent`, so it is clear that one configures the terminal UI and the other the remote agent; the settings on each tab are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: 終端指令退出後縮短等待，背景程序佔用時 1 秒內接續
title.en: Reduced Wait After Terminal Command Exits, Resuming Within 1 Second When Background Processes Hold Output

body.zh-TW: 請代理在終端機執行指令時，若指令啟動了持續在背景運作的程序，對話流程切換得更即時。⟦跟交響樂團的樂章銜接一樣，以前指揮剛放下指揮棒，只要後方定音鼓的餘音還沒徹底消散，整個樂團就要在台上乾等；現在只要主要樂器停奏，指揮便能立刻帶領大家進入下一段旋律。⟧以前終端機指令雖然已經執行完畢退出，但只要它衍生的背景程序仍佔用著輸出通道，代理會原地等待 5 秒才繼續往下走。現在這項等待已縮短至至多約 1 秒，讓代理能迅速接續執行後續任務。
body.en: When asking the agent to run commands in the terminal, if a command launches a process that continues running in the background, the conversation switches more promptly. ⟦Like the transition between movements in a symphony orchestra: previously, as soon as the conductor lowered the baton, if the reverberation of the timpani in the back had not completely died down, the entire orchestra had to wait idly on stage; now, as soon as the main instruments stop playing, the conductor can immediately lead everyone into the next melody.⟧ Previously, even though a terminal command had finished executing and exited, as long as a background process it spawned still held the output channel open, the agent would wait in place for 5 seconds before moving forward. This wait has now been shortened to at most about 1 second, allowing the agent to swiftly move on to subsequent tasks.

items.original: Improved how quickly the agent moves on after a terminal command exits while a background process it started still holds the command's output open, which now takes at most about 1 second instead of 5.

title.zh-TW: 子代理等待回應時標明工具名稱，精確掌握卡住原因
title.en: Subagents Waiting for Input Name Tool Directly to Pinpoint Causes of Pauses

body.zh-TW: 委派子代理執行任務的多工過程中，輸入框上方的狀態提示能直接看出它需要你做什麼。⟦就像診所診間外的叫號燈，以前只亮著含糊的「處理中」，病患在門外完全不知道該不該進去；現在燈號會直接改亮「等待驗光」，大家一看就知道接下來要配合哪個檢查項目。⟧以往在輸入框上方的子代理狀態列中，如果子代理卡住並等待你的輸入，狀態只會籠統顯示為 `Blocked · Processing...`，讓人無法判斷它究竟是在運算還是等候回應。現在狀態會直接列出卡住它的工具名稱，例如顯示為 `Blocked · AskQuestion`，清楚指出它正等著你回答問題。
body.en: During multitasking where subagents are delegated tasks, the status prompt above the input box directly reveals what it needs from you. ⟦Consider a call light outside a clinic exam room: previously, it only lit up with a vague "Processing," leaving patients outside unsure whether to enter; now the indicator directly switches to "Waiting for Optometry," so everyone knows at a glance which examination item to follow.⟧ Previously, in the subagent status row above the prompt, if a subagent was blocked waiting on your input, the status only vaguely displayed `Blocked · Processing...`, making it impossible to tell whether it was computing or waiting for a reply. The status now directly names the tool blocking it, such as displaying `Blocked · AskQuestion`, clearly indicating that it is waiting for you to answer a question.

items.original: Improved subagent rows above the prompt so a subagent that is blocked waiting on you names the tool it is waiting on, such as `Blocked · AskQuestion`, instead of `Blocked · Processing...`.

title.zh-TW: 終端沙盒限縮外掛真實令牌替換範圍，防止網址反射外洩
title.en: Terminal Sandbox Restricts Real Plugin Token Replacement to Prevent Leakage via URL Reflection

body.zh-TW: 終端機沙盒環境內運行的各類外掛程式，連線授權資訊的防護機制多了一道防線。⟦彷彿持代驗憑條領取機密文件，以前只要任何收件欄填上代號，系統都會換成正式印鑑，容易被回寄外洩；現在只准在指定的授權欄位換上真實印鑑，其他地方一律不予替換。⟧在外掛程式發出請求時，真實的授權令牌（token，用來向第三方服務驗證身分的憑證令牌）現在只會在網路請求的 `Authorization` 標頭中替換代用標記。這能防止惡意指令把代用標記刻意塞在網址或自訂標頭中，避免外部網站將替換後的真實令牌反射回傳而導致憑證外流。
body.en: For various plugins running in the terminal sandbox environment, an extra line of defense has been added to protect connection authorization details. ⟦Imagine claiming confidential documents with a temporary voucher: previously, whenever a code was entered in any recipient field, the system replaced it with an official seal, risking leaks if returned; now the real seal is applied only in the designated authorization field, with replacements prohibited everywhere else.⟧ When a plugin issues a request, real authorization tokens (credentials used to verify identity with third-party services) now replace stand-in markers only in a network request's `Authorization` header. This prevents malicious commands from deliberately stuffing stand-in markers into URLs or custom headers, avoiding credential leaks caused by external websites reflecting back the replaced real tokens.

items.original: Improved how plugin OAuth credentials are protected in the terminal sandbox: a plugin's real token now replaces its stand-in only in a request's `Authorization` header, so a command can no longer get a website to echo the real token back by sending the stand-in in another header or in the URL.

title.zh-TW: 修復 agy acp 工作階段狀態同步，提示取消與表單不再卡死
title.en: Fixed agy acp Session State Sync So Prompt Cancellations and Forms No Longer Hang

body.zh-TW:
透過 ACP 協定與編輯器長時間協同作業時，多項工作階段的中斷與通知問題已獲得修正。⟦有如郵政窗口的叫號系統，以前只要前一位民眾中途抽單，常常導致下一位號碼連帶作廢，舊表單還留在櫃檯；現在中途取消會確實結案，後續叫號與表單關閉都井然有序。⟧以前若在提示執行時關閉、重新載入或恢復工作階段，原本的提示會無限懸掛，現在會正式標示為已取消。手動取消提示也不再連帶中止隨後送出的下一道指令。

通知的傳遞順序也已校正，`session/update` 不會再晚於 `session/prompt` 回應才抵達。權限請求與提問表單若已在其他地方完成回答，或所屬提示已經結束，現在都會自動關閉，不再殘留於畫面上阻礙後續提示。
body.en:
When collaborating with editors over the ACP protocol for extended periods, several session interruption and notification issues have been resolved. ⟦A post office counter queue provides an apt comparison: previously, if the person ahead withdrew their application midway, the next ticket was often invalidated along with it while the old form sat on the counter; now midway cancellations close cleanly, keeping subsequent calling and form dismissals in good order.⟧ Previously, closing, reloading, or resuming a session while a prompt was running left the original prompt hanging indefinitely, but it is now officially marked as `cancelled`. Manually cancelling a prompt also no longer stops the next command sent right after it.

The delivery order of notifications has also been calibrated so that `session/update` no longer arrives after the `session/prompt` reply. Permission requests and question forms now close automatically if they are answered elsewhere or their prompt ends, rather than lingering on screen and blocking subsequent prompts.

items.original: Fixed several `agy acp` session bugs: closing, reloading, or resuming a session while a prompt runs now ends that prompt as `cancelled` instead of leaving it hanging, cancelling a prompt no longer also stops the next prompt sent right after it, `session/update` notifications no longer arrive after the `session/prompt` reply for that prompt, and permission requests and question forms now close when they are answered elsewhere or their prompt ends, instead of blocking later prompts or receiving their answers.

title.zh-TW: 修復 Windows 檔案編輯換行符號錯誤，改善非 ASCII 亂碼與行程釋放
title.en: Fixed Windows File Editing Line Ending Errors, Non-ASCII Garbled Text, and Process Cleanups

body.zh-TW:
Windows 使用者在終端操作時，檔案換行格式、文字編碼與外部工具殘留行程等問題已獲得修復。

針對採用 CRLF 換行符號的檔案，以前編輯常因找不到目標文字（target content not found）而中斷。現在會精準比對換行符號，新增的行數也會沿用檔案原本的換行格式。

當代理執行的指令輸出包含非 ASCII 字元時，以前容易顯示亂碼或直接報錯。現在會自動以 UTF-8 模式（`PYTHONUTF8=1`）執行 Python，並將 PowerShell 的輸出編碼切換為 UTF-8。若你自己已設定 `PYTHONUTF8`，就以你的設定為準。

透過標準輸入運行的 MCP 伺服器（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）停止後，其子行程也不會再殘留背景，解決外掛目錄因檔案被佔用而無法升級的困擾。
body.en:
For Windows users operating in the terminal, issues with file line ending formats, text encoding, and leftover external tool processes have been resolved.

Previously, editing files that use CRLF line endings often aborted because target content could not be found (`target content not found`). Edits now accurately match whichever line endings the file uses, and newly inserted lines preserve the file's original line ending format.

When command output run by the agent contains non-ASCII characters, it previously tended to display garbled text or throw errors. Python is now automatically run in UTF-8 mode (`PYTHONUTF8=1`), and PowerShell's output encoding is switched to UTF-8. If you have set `PYTHONUTF8` yourself, your setting takes precedence.

After stdio MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, an open standard for connecting AI to external tools) stop, their child processes no longer linger in the background. This resolves the issue where plugin directories could not be upgraded because files were in use.

items.original:
Fixed file edits on Windows failing with `target content not found` in files that use CRLF line endings, so edits now match whichever line endings the file uses and the lines they insert keep the file's line endings.
Fixed agent-run commands on Windows failing or returning garbled text when their output contains non-ASCII characters, by running Python in UTF-8 mode (`PYTHONUTF8=1`, unless you have set `PYTHONUTF8` yourself) and switching PowerShell's output encoding to UTF-8.
Fixed stdio MCP servers on Windows leaving their child processes running after the server stops, which could lock plugin folders and make plugin upgrades fail because the files were in use.

title.zh-TW: 企業登入與雲端憑證環境下，外掛市集與指令恢復正常運作
title.en: Plugin Marketplaces and Commands Restored Under Enterprise Login and Cloud Credential Environments

body.zh-TW: 依賴企業模型閘道或應用程式預設憑證（`AGY_ADC_AUTH`）登入的環境下，外掛管理功能現在能正常使用。以前在這類驗證環境下執行 `agy plugin` 指令，會遇到功能不可用且外掛市集完全空白的情況。現在這個問題已經修好，能正常列出外掛市集並執行各項外掛指令。
body.en: In environments that rely on an enterprise model gateway or Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`) for sign-in, plugin management features now work normally. Previously, running `agy plugin` commands in these authentication environments resulted in unavailable features and a completely empty plugin marketplace. This issue has now been resolved, properly listing plugin marketplaces and executing various plugin commands.

items.original: Fixed `agy plugin` commands being unavailable, with no plugin marketplaces listed, when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`) or through an enterprise model gateway.

title.zh-TW: browser 代理移出對話清單，回歸專屬子代理定位
title.en: browser Agent Removed from Conversation List to Retain Dedicated Subagent Role

body.zh-TW: 開啟新對話挑選要互動的代理時，選單不再顯示專供內部呼叫的工具。以前內建的 `browser` 代理會誤列在對話啟動清單中；但它本質上是設計給主代理在背景調用的子代理。現在它已從一般對話選單中移除，並維持原有的子代理運作方式。
body.en: When starting a new conversation and picking an agent to interact with, the menu no longer displays tools intended strictly for internal calls. Previously, the built-in `browser` agent was mistakenly listed among agents available to start a conversation with; however, it is fundamentally designed as a subagent invoked by the primary agent in the background. It has now been removed from the standard conversation menu while retaining its original operation as a subagent.

items.original: Fixed the built-in `browser` agent being listed among the agents you can start a conversation with, since it is meant to run only as a subagent, which it still does.

title.zh-TW: GNU screen 內複製功能修復，文字精準送入剪貼簿
title.en: Fixed Copying Inside GNU screen So Text Accurately Reaches Clipboard

body.zh-TW: 習慣在 GNU screen 終端環境中操作的使用者，剪貼簿現在能精確接收複製內容。以前在 GNU screen 內使用選取即複製或輸入 `/copy` 時，文字常常無法順利送入剪貼簿，選取較長文字時終端機畫面還會殘留多餘的雜亂字元。現在這個問題已經修好，複製內容會正確進入剪貼簿且畫面維持乾淨。
body.en: For users accustomed to working inside the GNU screen terminal environment, the clipboard now accurately receives copied content. Previously, using copy-on-select or entering `/copy` inside GNU screen often failed to deliver text to the clipboard, and selecting longer text left stray clutter characters on the terminal screen. This issue has now been resolved: copied text properly reaches the clipboard, and the screen stays clean.

items.original: Fixed copy-on-select and `/copy` inside GNU screen, so copied text now reaches your clipboard and long selections no longer leave stray characters in the terminal.

entries: Answered questions now have a blank line between them, except in compact mode (`/compact-mode`)
`/plugins` now counts only the plugin skills that load, and says how many were skipped because they link outside the plugin folder

title.zh-TW: 已回答的問題之間自動加入空行，精簡模式維持緊湊排版
title.en: Answered questions now automatically include a blank line between them, while compact mode preserves a tight layout

body.zh-TW: 當你在終端機連續向 AI 提出多個問題時，畫面上常常累積了長長一串對話紀錄。以前每輪問答緊密相接，文字擠在一起時很難一眼看清每個問題的段落邊界。⟦就像參觀藝廊時欣賞牆上的攝影作品，以前每幅照片緊緊挨著張貼，視線容易把不同主題混成一團；現在每組作品之間留出均勻空隙，瀏覽時就能立刻辨識各個段落的分界。⟧現在終端機處理完提問後，會在各個已回答的問題之間自動加入一行空白行。多了一行留白後，不論前一個問題的回答有多長，你都能一眼找出上一段問答的結尾。唯一的例外是當你開啟精簡模式（`/compact-mode`）時，介面會維持原有的緊湊排版而不加入空行，讓你在高度有限的視窗中能同時看到更多對話內容。
body.en: When you ask an AI multiple questions in a row in the terminal, a long conversation history often accumulates on the screen. Previously, each round of questions and answers sat flush against the next, making it difficult to clearly see the boundaries of each question when the text was packed tightly together. ⟦Picture browsing photography on an art gallery wall: previously, photos hung directly edge to edge, so your eyes could easily blur different themes together; now, even gaps between exhibits let you immediately spot where each section divides.⟧ Now, after the terminal finishes processing your questions, answered questions now have a blank line between them. With this extra blank line, no matter how long the previous answer was, you can easily locate the end of the prior exchange at a glance. title.zh-TW: `/plugins` 僅計算成功載入的技能，並標明因外部連結略過的數量

Now when you run `/plugins`, it counts only the plugin skills that load. If any skills are skipped because they link outside the plugin folder, the interface clearly indicates exactly how many items were skipped. Seeing the actual number of loaded skills helps you immediately gauge plugin scale and promptly inspect file paths if counts fall short. ⟦At a sports meet registration desk tallying competitors, officials previously counted every name on the roster toward attendance; now, referees record only athletes who successfully step into the designated check-in area, while posting on the board how many were excluded from the roster for running outside the boundary lines.⟧

title.zh-TW: macOS 與 Linux 支援檔案系統拒絕規則，嚴格阻擋敏感路徑讀寫
title.en: Filesystem Deny Rules Supported on macOS and Linux to Strictly Block Sensitive Path Access

body.zh-TW: 當你在權限設定檔中擴充 `:ask-me` 並加入檔案系統 `deny` 規則時，系統現在會在 macOS 與 Linux 上確實強制執行。無論是工作區根目錄的萬用字元（如 `**/*.pem`），還是絕對路徑與家目錄 `~/` 的拒絕規則，都會直接拒絕符合條件的讀寫請求，並限制沙盒 Shell 存取指令啟動時已存在的符合路徑。⟦跟金庫的門禁感應卡一樣，原本只交代警衛口頭留意，現在閘門讀卡機直接鎖定黑名單區域，非許可人員碰觸感應區就立刻鳴笛拒絕。⟧在 Linux 上，指令執行中途於萬用字元下新建的檔案不受保護；macOS 則透過 Seatbelt 正規表達式（用符號匹配字串的語法）即時防堵且無快照空窗。至於尚未存在的路徑，會在第一個缺失層級先行遮蔽，而設定檔在其他位置的寫入授權則維持不變。
body.en: When you extend `:ask-me` in a permission profile with filesystem `deny` rules, the system now enforces them on macOS and Linux. Whether using workspace-root deny globs (such as `**/*.pem`) or absolute and home directory `~/` deny rules, matching read and write requests are directly refused, and sandboxed shell access to matching paths that exist when each shell command starts is blocked. ⟦Just as a vault card reader secures restricted areas, where guards were previously only told to keep watch verbally, the card reader now actively locks down blacklisted zones and sounds an alarm whenever unauthorized personnel touch the sensor.⟧ On Linux, files created mid-command under a deny glob are not covered. macOS prevents them live through Seatbelt regex (syntax for matching text patterns with symbols) with no snapshot window. Denies on not-yet-existing paths are masked at their first missing component, while the profile keeps its write grants elsewhere.

body.zh-TW: 當你要求代理人製作 3D 網頁、瀏覽器遊戲或處理 Blender 專案時，現在內建的 `visual-coding` 技能會在動筆寫程式前，主動引導代理人使用負責該領域的單一內建技能，避免單次請求同時啟動兩套相互衝突的建置流程。⟦宛如醫院的分診服務台，病患剛進門就先依症狀指引至專屬診間，不再讓兩個科別同時搶著收治同一位病人。⟧針對 `/game-3d-visuals` 指令，現在會依序拆分為規劃、建置與審查三個步驟執行，並在每步完成後向待辦清單回報單行結果。該技能現在也會明確為每次管線執行命名，首次啟動不再遭到拒絕或被迫重新嘗試。
body.en: When you ask an agent to build a 3D page, a browser game, or handle a Blender project, the built-in `visual-coding` skill now actively directs the agent to the single built-in skill responsible for that domain before writing any code, preventing one request from launching two competing build processes. ⟦Picture a hospital triage desk directing incoming patients to designated specialty rooms based on symptoms, stopping two departments from competing to treat the same patient.⟧ For the `/game-3d-visuals` command, execution is now split into three sequential steps: planning, building, and reviewing, posting a one-line result to the todo list after each step finishes. title.zh-TW: YOLO 模式保留提問工具，支援非同步向使用者確認需求
title.en: YOLO Mode Retains Question Tool and Supports Async Inquiries to Confirm Requirements

body.zh-TW: 平時使用 `--yolo` 參數讓工具自動執行任務時，往往既希望節省確認步驟，又擔心重要決策缺乏溝通。現在 `--yolo` 不再全面扣留提問，而是保留了 `request_user_input` 提問工具，並啟用非同步提問機制，讓代理人在背景運作時仍能提出關鍵問題。⟦好比全自動導航的貨運卡車，平常維持自主駕駛，遇到收件地址不清楚時能在儀表板發出非同步通知等你確認，不必被迫停在路中央發呆。⟧如果你希望執行過程完全不被打擾、不詢問任何問題，只要額外加上 `--disable-request-user-input` 參數，就能徹底關閉提問。
body.en: When using the `--yolo` flag to let tools execute tasks automatically, you often want to save confirmation steps without missing important decisions. The `--yolo` flag no longer withholds questions completely; instead, it keeps the `request_user_input` question tool and enables an async questioning mechanism, allowing the agent to ask essential questions while running in the background. ⟦Like an autonomous delivery truck driving smoothly on its own, it can post an async notification on the dashboard for your confirmation whenever a delivery address is unclear, rather than stalling out in the middle of the road.⟧ If you prefer the execution process to run entirely uninterrupted without asking anything, pass `--disable-request-user-input` to disable questions completely.

title.zh-TW: 嚴格隔離未受信任工作區，伺服端權限異常時主動降級重設
title.en: Strict Isolation for Untrusted Workspaces with Proactive Reset on Server Permission Anomalies

body.zh-TW: 打開未知來源的專案資料夾時，安全性設定會更嚴密地劃清界線。未受信任工作區的工作階段不再接收先前受信任工作階段記錄的專案規則；工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）復原也遵守相同的保護路徑。未受信任工作區的託管工作階段不再執行工作區狀態檢查或 Sapling 快照，未建立信任就拒絕繼續。⟦猶如訪客不再繼承前人的通行鑰匙，門禁紀錄有缺漏時，也不能沿用舊鑰匙放行。⟧`muse serve` 恢復、分支或開啟側邊對話時，若歷史遺失權限變更，不再沿用較寬鬆的舊權限：會重設為預設值，保留較嚴格的已存設定，只有兩組設定無法安全合併才轉唯讀。遺失前「允許此工作階段」的授權失效。恢復時選擇的權限設定檔在重設後套用；若不允許重設，就取代重設。無安全重設途徑或管理原則禁止時，會拒絕開啟並要求另開新對話。
body.en: When opening project folders from unknown sources, security settings draw a stricter boundary. Sessions in untrusted workspaces no longer receive project rules recorded by earlier trusted sessions. Session worktree (Git's feature for running multiple parallel copies of the same project) recovery now enforces the same protected paths. Hosted sessions in untrusted workspaces no longer run workspace status checks or Sapling snapshots, refusing to continue if trust is never established. ⟦A visitor no longer inherits access keys left behind by a predecessor, and missing log entries also prevent old keys from granting admission.⟧ When `muse serve` resumes, forks, or opens a side chat from history that lost a permission change, it no longer reopens with older, wider permissions: it resets to defaults, keeps your saved settings when they were stricter, or switches to read-only when the two cannot be safely combined. Prior approvals for "allow for this session" given before the loss stop applying. A permission profile chosen when resuming applies after the reset, or replaces the reset when resetting is not allowed. When no safe reset exists or managed policy forbids it, the chat refuses to open and asks you to start a new chat.

title.zh-TW: 分支對話遇磁碟寫入失敗不中斷，重啟自動略過異常回合
title.en: Forked Chats Continue Through Disk Write Failures and Skip Abnormal Turns on Reopen

body.zh-TW: 在磁碟空間不足的環境下建立分支對話，若是某次回合開頭未能成功寫入硬碟，現在不會再卡死整體流程。這類分支對話在完成壓縮並重新開啟後仍可正常運作，重啟時也會再度儲存檢查點；應用程式或其他客戶端載入時，不再阻擋後續檢查點儲存，即使是從已壓縮對話建立的分支也能順利接續。⟦就跟搭乘區間火車碰上某節車廂門鎖損壞一樣，站務員會將該車廂清空並在發車時廣播通知一次，其餘車廂與列車排班依舊準時行駛。⟧系統會將未能成功寫入的回合排除在紀錄之外，並在每次重新載入時清楚提醒你一次，確保對話能持續進行而不中斷。
body.en: Creating a forked chat in low-disk-space environments no longer blocks the entire flow if the start of one of its turns cannot be written to disk. Such forked chats continue working normally after compacting and reopening, saving checkpoints again upon restart. Loading them in an application or another client no longer blocks subsequent checkpoints, allowing forks from compacted chats to continue smoothly. ⟦When a commuter train encounters a damaged carriage door lock, station staff clear that carriage and make a single announcement before departure, while the rest of the train keeps running on schedule.⟧ The system leaves unwritten turns out of the record and reminds you once per reopen, ensuring the chat can proceed without interruption.

title.zh-TW: 磁碟滿載或存取中斷自動復原，錯誤排除即刻接續儲存進度
title.en: Automatic Recovery from Full Disks or Interrupted Storage Resumes Progress Immediately

body.zh-TW: 面對暫時性的硬碟存取異常，工作階段現在具備更靈活的自我復原能力。工具執行結果若因磁碟已滿等原因儲存失敗，對話依然能立即執行壓縮，重啟後該回合會完整保留並標註結果已遺失，不再無故消失。當讀取對話檔案因短暫輸入輸出錯誤受阻，一旦讀取恢復正常，對話便會重新儲存進度，不必被迫重啟。即便子代理訊息或背景紀錄因磁碟空間不足存檔失敗，壓縮檢查點無須重啟即可恢復運作。任務中途或背景儲存遭遇短暫磁碟故障時，只要錯誤排除，在下個檢查點便會接續存檔，範圍亦涵蓋側邊對話與已寫入磁碟的紀錄。在寫入持續失敗期間，系統也會減少重複的工作階段日誌登記，避免資源耗損。
body.en: Sessions now feature more resilient self-recovery when encountering temporary storage access errors. If saving a tool result fails due to a full disk or similar issue, the chat can still compact immediately; after a restart, that turn is preserved with the result marked as lost instead of disappearing. When reading a chat file is blocked by a brief I/O error, the chat resumes saving progress once the read succeeds, without requiring a restart. Compaction checkpoints continue working without a chat restart even if saving a subagent message or background record fails due to lack of disk space. When a brief disk error occurs mid-task or interrupts a background save, progress saving resumes at the next checkpoint once the error clears, covering side chats and records already written to disk. While disk writes keep failing, the system also reduces repeated session-log bookkeeping to avoid consuming resources.

items.original:
A chat whose tool result could not be saved (for example on a full disk) can compact again right away, and after a restart that turn is kept with the result shown as lost, instead of disappearing
When a chat's file could not be read while loading it for a save (a brief I/O error), the chat goes back to saving its progress once the read works again, instead of staying unable to save until restart
After a subagent message or other background record could not be saved to a full disk, compaction checkpoints work again without restarting the chat
After a brief storage error in the middle of a task, the chat goes back to saving its progress at the next checkpoint once the error clears, instead of waiting for the task's next tool call or its end
After a brief disk error interrupts one background save, the chat goes back to saving its progress once the error clears, also when the save had fully reached the disk or belonged to a side chat
Reduce repeated session-log bookkeeping while disk writes are failing

title.zh-TW: 長期目標與對話壓縮穩定保存，回合清理失敗會顯示警告
title.en: Long-Running Goals and Chat Compactions Save Reliably with Warnings on Cleanup Failures

body.zh-TW: 長時間執行複雜任務時，對話歷史與檢查點的保存機制能維持正常節奏。漫長的 `/goal` 任務會正常儲存恢復檢查點，使內容維持精簡並迅速恢復，不再每次壓縮後逐漸變慢。對話呼叫子代理再同時執行多項工具後，後續檢查點不再停止儲存；提示詞格式神似訊息封套，也不會阻礙後續工作階段儲存恢復檢查點。模型回應提早結束時，自動壓縮不再遺失監視器訊息；背景任務尚未確認儲存時觸發壓縮，也會儲存檢查點，並保留舊歷史直到背景儲存結果確定，不再跳過儲存。如果回合結束後的清理持續失敗（例如目標計帳或即時狀態），對話會在該回合後顯示一次警告，指名失敗項目；若已進入另一回合，則下次開啟對話時顯示。若警告本身未能存檔，就只在你仍停留於該回合時顯示。
body.en: When executing complex tasks over long durations, the saving mechanism for chat history and checkpoints maintains a steady cadence. Long `/goal` sessions reliably save resume checkpoints again, keeping content compact and restoring quickly instead of slowing down after every compaction. After a chat messages a subagent and runs multiple tools at once, subsequent checkpoints no longer stop saving. Prompts formatted like session-message envelopes also no longer prevent future sessions from saving resume checkpoints. Automatic compaction no longer loses Monitor messages when a model response ends early. Triggering compaction while a background task save remains unconfirmed still saves checkpoints, keeping older history until the background save resolves instead of skipping the save. If cleanup after a finished turn keeps failing (such as goal accounting or live turn state), the chat displays one warning naming the failed item right after that turn, or the next time you open the chat if you have moved on to another turn. If the warning itself cannot be saved, it appears only while you remain on that turn.

items.original:
When cleanup after a finished turn keeps failing (goal accounting or the live turn state), the chat now shows one "cleanup failed after this turn" warning naming what gave up, instead of failing silently. It shows right after that turn, or the next time you open the chat if you have already moved on to another turn (in the rare case that the warning itself could not be saved, it shows only while you are still on that turn)
Long `/goal` sessions save their resume checkpoints again, so they stay compact and resume quickly instead of slowing down after every compaction
A chat that messaged a subagent and then ran several tools at once no longer stops saving checkpoints for the rest of the session
Fixed automatic compaction losing Monitor messages after a model response ended early
A prompt that looks like a session-message envelope no longer stops later sessions from saving resume checkpoints
A compaction that runs while a background task's save is still unconfirmed now saves its checkpoint (keeping the older history until the task's save resolves) instead of skipping it

title.zh-TW: 背景工作流程保留待辦清單，終止與暫停狀態回報更明確
title.en: Background Workflows Retain Todo Lists with Clearer Stopping and Pausing Reports

body.zh-TW: 讓代理人在背景執行長時間任務時，你能更清楚掌握各項流程的即時動態。啟動背景工作流程後，待辦清單在該流程運作期間會持續保留在螢幕上，不再隨著觸發它的對話回合結束而立刻消失。當你手動中斷操作時，停止訊息會明確標註停下的是工作流程還是背景指令。⟦就像工廠中央監控台的流水線看板，即便操作員切換畫面，組裝進度依然常駐顯示，按下急停鈕時也會清楚標明停機的是輸送帶還是檢驗站。⟧若工作流程剛好執行完畢才按下暫停，畫面會直接回報已完成並顯示執行結果，避免卡在無結果的暫停狀態。使用帶有 `stop: true` 的 `session/leave` 時，若工作流程因停止紀錄衝突而無法停止，離開操作會失敗，工作階段仍留在原主機。已知限制是：即使用新的指令識別碼重試，也會持續失敗，直到主機程序重啟。
body.en: When letting an agent run long-running tasks in the background, you get clearer visibility into the real-time status of each process. After launching a background workflow, the todo list remains on screen while the workflow runs, rather than disappearing as soon as the turn that triggered it ends. When you manually stop an operation, the stopping message clearly indicates whether a workflow or a background command was stopped. ⟦Much like a central assembly dashboard in a factory, progress remains visible on screen even when operators switch views, and pressing an emergency stop clarifies whether the conveyor belt or the inspection station was paused.⟧ If you pause a workflow right after it finishes, the interface directly reports that it has completed and displays the execution result, avoiding getting stuck in a paused state with no result. When using `session/leave` with `stop: true`, if a workflow cannot be stopped due to a conflicting stop record, the leave fails and the session remains with its host. As a known limitation, such leaves continue to fail even when retried with a new command id, until the host process restarts.

items.original:
Stopping messages say whether a workflow or a background command was stopped
`session/leave` with `stop: true` no longer releases a session while one of its workflows cannot be stopped (its stop record is in conflict); the leave fails and the session stays with its host, including when you retry it with a new command id; until the host process restarts, such a leave keeps failing (a known limitation)
The todo list now stays on screen while a background workflow is still running, instead of disappearing as soon as the turn that launched it ends
Pausing a Workflow that has just finished now reports that it already finished and shows its result, instead of leaving the Workflow paused with no result

title.zh-TW: 子代理通訊保留文字摘要，取消佇列與對等時間軸正常運作
title.en: Subagent Communication Preserves Plain Summaries as Unqueue and Peer Timelines Function Normally

body.zh-TW: 在多代理人協同運作的環境中，訊息傳遞與佇列排程的管理更加井然有序。透過遠端工作階段向子代理發送便籤時，文字摘要會完整保留，不再遺失原貌；當子代理正忙於處理其他事務，等待中的便籤會明確標記為排隊中，方便追蹤派工狀況。⟦如同辦公室的專案交接留言板，交代給助理的便條紙會整齊貼在排隊欄位並保留原始重點，想抽回尚未處理的留言也能隨時撤下。⟧使用 `turn/unqueue` 撤回排隊訊息時，即便訊息排在內部回合後方，也能順利取消，不再誤報找不到執行個體而強制執行。工作階段自動接收訊息後，對等節點的訊息時間軸亦會正常顯示，不再出現無法使用的錯誤提示。
body.en: In multi-agent collaborative environments, message routing and queue scheduling are organized more cleanly. Notes sent to a subagent over a remote session preserve their plain summary rather than losing their original appearance. When a subagent is busy handling other tasks, waiting notes clearly show Queued rows to facilitate tracking dispatch status. ⟦In an office handover board, notes assigned to an assistant stay neatly in the queue column with their original takeaways intact, and pending messages can be pulled back at any time.⟧ When revoking a queued message using `turn/unqueue`, the cancellation succeeds even if the message waits behind an internal turn, instead of incorrectly failing with `missing_run` and running the message anyway. After a session accepts a message automatically, the peer message timeline also displays normally, without showing an unavailable error.

items.original:
Notes sent to a subagent over a remote session keep their plain summary
Removing a queued message with `turn/unqueue` now works when the message is waiting behind an internal turn, instead of failing with `missing_run` and running the message anyway
Notes waiting on a busy subagent now show Queued rows while they wait
The peer message timeline no longer shows as unavailable after a session accepts a message automatically

title.zh-TW: 桌面端同步第三方模型選單，工作階段命名回歸且降低記憶體
title.en: Desktop Syncs Third-Party Models, Restoring Session Names and Reducing Memory

body.zh-TW: 切換使用不同介面時，模型選單與工作階段清單現在具備一致的體驗。桌面端與其他連線客戶端現在提供與終端機模型選單完全相同的第三方模型選項。你先前為工作階段自訂的名稱會重新列在清單中，並能依據自己的歷史紀錄直接使用 `muse resume <name>` 恢復對話。⟦仿照商品目錄的輕量索引設計，展架上只陳列品名與貨號，不必把整批庫存貨物堆在走道上。⟧其他工作階段仍在執行時，啟動應用程式或 `muse serve` 會減少記憶體用量，因為列出工作階段清單不再保留每個執行中工作階段的完整歷史副本。使用 `/feedback` 回報問題時，若紀錄過於龐大，系統會自動縮減至合適大小並附上標註，不再因檔案過大而失敗。
body.en: When switching between different interfaces, the model menu and session list now provide a consistent experience. Desktop and other connected clients now offer the exact same third-party model options as the terminal model picker. Session names you customized earlier show up again in the list and can directly resume conversations with `muse resume <name>`, read from each session's own history. ⟦Following a lightweight catalog index design, display shelves only present item names and item numbers without stacking the entire inventory stock in the aisles.⟧ Starting the app or `muse serve` while other sessions are running uses less memory, because listing sessions no longer keeps a full copy of each running session's history. When reporting issues with `/feedback`, if a record is very large, the system automatically shortens it to fit and adds a note, so it no longer fails due to oversized files.

items.original:
Desktop and other connected clients offer the same third-party models as the terminal model picker
Session names you gave earlier show up again in the session list and work with `muse resume <name>`, read from each session's own history
`/feedback` uploads with a very large session record no longer fail; the record is shortened to fit and the shortening is noted
Starting the app or `muse serve` while other sessions are running uses much less memory, because listing sessions no longer keeps a full copy of each running session's history

title.zh-TW: 掛鉤注入資訊限制於當前對話，避免模型重新處理完整歷史
title.en: Hook Context Stays in Current Conversation, Preventing Full History Reprocessing

body.zh-TW: 如果你平時利用自動化腳本擴充提示詞或工具結果，現在資料注入的範圍劃分得更為明確。在提示詞或工具呼叫後，透過掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）加入的上下文資訊，現在會被嚴格限制在該資訊抵達的對話之中。⟦看齊公文批閱的浮貼便籤機制，新加上的審核意見只貼在當前公文夾，不必把整份歷史檔案抽出來從頭到尾重審一遍。⟧新增掛鉤規則後，下次呼叫模型不再重新處理整段對話。
body.en: If you typically use automation scripts to augment prompts or tool results, the scope of data injection is now more clearly defined. After a prompt or tool call, context added through hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) is now strictly confined to the conversation where that information arrived. ⟦Adopting the sticky-note mechanism used in document review, newly added review comments are attached solely to the current folder instead of pulling out the entire historical archive to re-examine from start to finish.⟧ After adding a new hook rule, the next model call no longer re-processes the entire conversation.

items.original: Context that hooks add after a prompt or tool call now stays in the conversation where it arrived, so a new hook rule no longer makes the whole conversation re-process on the next model call

entries: **The quota keepers and the Antigravity and Muse quota checks now find CLIs installed with nvm, Volta, fnm, mise, asdf, bun or pnpm.** The menu bar app starts with a short PATH, so these installs used to look missing, and npm-installed tools could not find `node`.

**Turning off the status line from the menu now stays off after a restart.** The app used to turn it back on at the next launch. Uninstalling also restores your own status line if you had turned it off, instead of deleting it.
**A broken `~/.claude/settings.json` no longer stops the menu bar app from starting.** The app skips the setup prompt and keeps showing usage for every tool.

**Uninstalling removes everything usage added to Claude Code.** `usage unsetup` and `--unsetup` now also turn off the quota reminder hook, the side panel and beginner mode; your own hooks and settings stay.
**Antigravity usage updates while a conversation is still running.** New usage written to the database's journal file used to wait until the conversation ended.
**A custom Claude Code data folder (`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`) refreshes as fast as the default one.** Changes there could take up to 15 minutes to appear.
**The Codex reset time no longer keeps moving.** When Codex reports only "resets in N seconds", the countdown now starts from when that message was logged, not from each refresh.

**The terminal report shows local times.** Reset times and session start times were shown in UTC, and daily averages near midnight used the UTC date. Tables whose records all have zero tokens no longer crash, the per-minute rate in the blocks view no longer counts cache reads (matching the menu bar), and `usage sessions --sort sessions` falls back to the default order instead of crashing.

**The HTML report's Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days and This month count from the day the report was made.** They used to count from the last day with usage, so Today could show a day from last week. The report also opens after you change time zones, or when a transcript has a timestamp without a time zone.
**The menu bar icons follow the top three tools even when their percentages are equal.** On daylight saving days, the Today project ranking also counts the first hour correctly.

**Codex setup no longer edits text inside your `config.toml` instructions.** If a multi-line instruction contains a line such as `[tui]`, setup leaves the file unchanged and asks you to adjust `status_line` by hand.

**The curl install script and the LaunchAgent script work again.** The install script downloaded the hook from a folder that no longer exists, and the LaunchAgent script failed on accounts without `~/Library/LaunchAgents`.

title.zh-TW: 額度查詢支援多種安裝工具，用量與重置倒數即時更新
title.en: Quota Checks Support More Installers, with Real-Time Usage and Reset Countdowns

body.zh-TW: 在背景同時跑多個 AI 對話或使用不同的套件管理器時，選單列上的額度與用量更新不再慢半拍。⟦跟看運動手錶的即時心率一樣，每步消耗當場結算，不再等跑完全程才算，計時也不會每次重設。⟧選單列 app 啟動時 PATH 較短，過去用 nvm、Volta、fnm、mise、asdf、bun 或 pnpm 安裝的指令常被當成沒裝，npm 工具也找不到 `node`。現在額度保持與 Antigravity、Muse 額度查詢皆能正常找到。Antigravity 對話中寫入資料庫日誌的新用量會即時計入，不用等對話結束。自訂 Claude Code 資料夾（`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`）也改為即時同步，不再延遲最多 15 分鐘。當 Codex 回報「N 秒後重置」時，倒數改從記錄時間起算，重新整理不再重置秒數。
body.en: When running multiple AI conversations in the background or using different package managers, quota and usage updates in the menu bar no longer lag behind. ⟦Think of checking real-time heart rate on a sports watch: each step's exertion is settled on the spot instead of waiting until the run is over, and the timer does not reset every time.⟧ The menu bar app starts with a short PATH, so commands installed with nvm, Volta, fnm, mise, asdf, bun or pnpm were often treated as missing, and npm-installed tools could not find `node`. Now the quota keepers and the Antigravity and Muse quota checks find them reliably. New usage written to the database journal during an Antigravity conversation is counted in real time without waiting for the conversation to finish. A custom Claude Code data folder (`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`) now syncs in real time instead of lagging by up to 15 minutes. When Codex reports "resets in N seconds", the countdown now starts from the recorded time so refreshing no longer resets the seconds.

items.original:
**The quota keepers and the Antigravity and Muse quota checks now find CLIs installed with nvm, Volta, fnm, mise, asdf, bun or pnpm.** The menu bar app starts with a short PATH, so these installs used to look missing, and npm-installed tools could not find `node`.
**Antigravity usage updates while a conversation is still running.** New usage written to the database's journal file used to wait until the conversation ended.
**A custom Claude Code data folder (`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`) refreshes as fast as the default one.** Changes there could take up to 15 minutes to appear.

title.zh-TW: 安裝與移除清理更乾淨，保護設定檔不被誤改
title.en: Cleaner Installs and Uninstalls Protect Configuration Files from Accidental Edits

body.zh-TW:
平常微調終端機設定或是移除工具，最怕個人偏好被意外改動，甚至因設定檔損毀而讓 app 開不起來。

從選單關掉顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列後，重開會保持關閉。執行 `usage unsetup` 或 `--unsetup` 會關掉額度提醒掛鉤（特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）、側邊面板與新手模式。移除時會還原你自己關掉的狀態列，並保留個人設定。

若 `~/.claude/settings.json` 損毀，選單列 app 仍會略過提示照常啟動並顯示各工具用量。

Codex 設定不再誤改 `config.toml`，若多行指令含 `[tui]` 則保持檔案不動，並提示手動修改 `status_line`。

curl 安裝腳本與 LaunchAgent 腳本失效的問題皆已修復。
body.en:
When tweaking terminal settings or removing tools, the biggest worry is having personal preferences unexpectedly changed, or even having apps fail to launch due to corrupted config files.

Turning off the status line shown at the bottom of the terminal from the menu now keeps it off after a restart. Running `usage unsetup` or `--unsetup` turns off the quota reminder hook (a small program triggered by specific events), the side panel, and beginner mode. Uninstalling restores your own status line if you turned it off, while preserving your personal settings.

If `~/.claude/settings.json` is corrupted, the menu bar app still skips the setup prompt and starts as usual to show usage for each tool.

Codex setup no longer accidentally edits `config.toml`, leaving the file untouched if multi-line instructions contain `[tui]` and prompting you to manually adjust `status_line`.

Broken curl install scripts and LaunchAgent scripts have both been fixed.

items.original:
**Turning off the status line from the menu now stays off after a restart.** The app used to turn it back on at the next launch. Uninstalling also restores your own status line if you had turned it off, instead of deleting it.
**A broken `~/.claude/settings.json` no longer stops the menu bar app from starting.** The app skips the setup prompt and keeps showing usage for every tool.
**Uninstalling removes everything usage added to Claude Code.** `usage unsetup` and `--unsetup` now also turn off the quota reminder hook, the side panel and beginner mode; your own hooks and settings stay.

title.zh-TW: 報表對齊本地時間與產生日，修復統計偏差與當掉問題
title.en: Reports Align with Local Time and Generation Dates, Fixing Skewed Stats and Crashes

body.zh-TW:
想精確掌握每日的用量花費，現在終端機與 HTML 報表都能忠實反映你的本地作息。

終端機報表的重置時間與工作階段開始時間改用本地時間，午夜前後的日均值也不再依 UTC 計算。紀錄全是零 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）的表格不再當掉。區塊畫面的每分鐘速率不再計入快取（cache，把算過的結果暫存直接用）讀取，與選單列保持一致。執行 `usage sessions --sort sessions` 時會自動套用預設排序，不再當掉。

HTML 報表的「今日／最近 7 天／最近 30 天／本月」改從產生日起算，不再以最後有用量的那天計算而顯示成上週資料。切換時區或對話紀錄含有未標時區的時間戳記時，報表皆可正常打開。

選單列前三名工具百分比相同時圖示會跟著更換，夏令時間切換當天的專案排行也會正確算入第一個小時。
body.en:
If you want to track daily usage expenses precisely, terminal and HTML reports now faithfully reflect your local schedule.

Reset times and session start times in terminal reports now use local time, and daily averages around midnight are no longer calculated using UTC dates. Tables whose records are all zero tokens (units of text processed and billed by AI) no longer crash. The per-minute rate in the blocks view no longer counts cache reads, matching the menu bar. Running `usage sessions --sort sessions` automatically applies the default sort order instead of crashing.

Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days and This month in the HTML report now count from the day the report was generated instead of the last day with usage, preventing them from showing data from last week. The report also opens properly after switching time zones or when transcripts contain timestamps without a time zone.

Menu bar icons update accordingly when the top three tools share equal percentages, and project rankings on daylight saving transition days now correctly include the first hour.

**The terminal report shows local times.** Reset times and session start times were shown in UTC, and daily averages near midnight used the UTC date. **The HTML report's Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days and This month count from the day the report was made.** They used to count from the last day with usage, so Today could show a day from last week. title.zh-TW: --attach 憑證檢查延後至上傳端點並由伺服器裁定 GitHub App 權限
title.en: Defer `--attach` Credential Checks to Upload Endpoint and Let Server Arbitrate GitHub App Permissions

body.zh-TW: 在自動化流程中使用 GitHub CLI 發布內容時，若想隨附測試日誌或建置成品，通常會使用 `--attach` 參數打包檔案。⟦就像去快遞站寄送特殊包裹，以前臨櫃店員只要在清單上找不到對應代號就當場拒收，現在門市先將包裹轉交後端物流中心，由總部依照權限統一核對資格。⟧過去命令列工具會在終端機本機端提前檢查身分，容易直接攔下自動化工具的上傳請求。現在 GitHub CLI 將 `--attach` 的憑證檢查延後到上傳端點處理。GitHub 伺服器端會直接裁定哪些 GitHub App 的安裝權杖（token，向伺服器驗證身分的授權令牌）具備附加檔案的權限。使用 GitHub App 執行排程任務時，能否附加檔案，改由 GitHub 伺服器裁定；`--attach` 的憑證檢查則延後到上傳端點處理。
body.en: When publishing content in automated workflows using GitHub CLI, if you want to include test logs or build artifacts, you typically use the `--attach` flag to bundle files. ⟦Picture sending a special package at a courier station: counter clerks previously rejected parcels on the spot whenever a matching code was missing from their list, but now the station forwards packages to the backend logistics center so headquarters can centrally verify eligibility based on permissions.⟧ Previously, the command-line tool checked credentials early on the local terminal side, easily blocking upload requests from automated tools outright. Now, GitHub CLI defers `--attach` credential checks to the upload endpoint. The GitHub server directly arbitrates which GitHub App installation tokens (authorization credentials used to verify identity with the server) have permission to attach files. When running scheduled tasks with a GitHub App, whether files can be attached is decided by the GitHub server; `--attach` credential checks are deferred to the upload endpoint.
